motionPromptOverrides.Land_Light: A person lands softly on both feet, bending both knees and lowering the hips into a shallow squat to cushion the landing. Both feet stay planted as the person smoothly rises into a balanced standing stance.
motionPromptOverrides.Land_Heavy: A person lands on both feet in a deep squat, bending the knees fully and dropping the hips low between the feet to absorb a heavy impact. The feet stay flat on the floor as the person pauses briefly in the deep crouch, then rises smoothly into a balanced standing stance.
motionPromptOverrides.Roll: A person performs one forward shoulder roll along the ground. Starting in a low crouch, the person tucks the head and knees, rolls over one shoulder and across the upper back, then brings both feet underneath the body and rises into a balanced standing stance.
